final: WITH g AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS c FROM scanspatial GROUP BY arcref), t AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS total FROM g WHERE c IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(c) > 0), p AS (SELECT g.arcref, g.c, CAST(g.c AS REAL) / t.total AS ratio FROM g JOIN t ON t.total IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS av FROM p HAVING COUNT(c) > 0), k AS (SELECT p.c, p.ratio, p.c - a.av AS diff FROM p JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE p.c > a.av) SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
